controls.parity_recompute_limit: Waveform samples are not archived; trimmed numerical equality is an instrumented runtime assertion. Repeated whole-grid and trimmed hashes are independently checked.

audio.scope: This probe was not selected; no no-fault or coverage claim is made.

progress.exposure_scope: Sampled heartbeat exposure; spans end at recovery or workload stop, or remain open during the run

UI.scope: GUI-thread frameSwapped notifications; not physical presentation latency
UI.exposure_scope: Only transition pulses stream; false-pulse observation total and heartbeat maxima are instrumented summary fields.

trace_checks.clock_ticks_scope: SC_CLK_TCK from analysis host; CPU conversion requires matching collection-host clock tick rate
trace_checks.sampling_scope: Successful process/system snapshots; requested interval is recorded separately. Capture cost excludes trace write; gaps include work, requested sleep and scheduling. Counter deltas require stable identities; sched_schedstats=0 limits interpretation. CPU first-to-last excludes process work before first sample. FD read errors do not identify a cause.

interpretation: Global observed p99 alone does not show absence of rare target misses.
Process-alive polling is not proof of continuous UI rendering.
FrameSwapped notifications do not measure physical presentation latency.

acceptance.parity_scope: Full same-grid chunks require identical SHA-256; trimmed seeks use allclose(rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5) and record exact equality/max difference.
acceptance.active_cancel_scope: Wait 150 ms after the supervisor started event, then revalidate generation/request. No GPU submission timestamp is observed.
acceptance.scope: synthetic saturated delivery with requested load=ui; no stem playback/full deck or musical-quality claim

probe_status_scope: With no selected probes, selected-load coverage has no probe requirement; absent audio/UI remains not_run with null faults/measurements, not a measured no-fault pass.

lifecycle_checks.scope: Restoration compares recorded entry state; prior profile is not assumed power-saver.

guard.scope: Window application timing is separate from continuous UI frame evidence; a positive application offset means a startup interval before guard installation.

reference_comparison.scope: Sequential trials toggle one selected benchmark child at a time. Fixed cooldown and starting temperature/host conditions must be reviewed separately; no causal proof from this audit.

notes: VmRSS, VmHWM and VmSwap are exact /proc/<pid>/status fields in kB.
DRM values retain their exact fdinfo field names and units; duplicate client IDs per device are sampled once.
Field type or unit changes are retained as separate observations; maxima are compared only within the same unit.
DRM client maxima can occur at different times; do not add maxima or combine them with RSS as a total or shared GPU peak.
CPU seconds cover the first through last successful sample, excluding earlier process work.
Process count fields retain exact stat/status names; status context-switch counts describe the main thread. Compare cumulative counters only within the same PID/start identity.
Full rows stream to the optional trace; observer memory retains per-process/client maxima and first/last counters rather than sample history.

trace.timestamp_clock: time.monotonic; sampled after process and optional system reads
trace.scheduling_scope: Per-task schedstat sums. Runtime and runqueue wait use ns; timeslices and read_errors are counts. Compare deltas only with identical task_ids and no read errors.
trace.capture_scope: Capture elapsed covers process/system reads before aggregation and trace output. Previous-sample gaps also include trace write time and the requested interval; they do not identify scheduling delays alone.

system_sampling.scope: Host sysfs/proc/statvfs snapshots. Meminfo preserves kB; vmstat fields are separate cumulative kernel counters, not interchangeable units. PSI totals use microseconds and averages use percent. Scratch free includes reserved blocks; available excludes them. RAPL is cumulative energy with a wrap range, not power. Throttle counters can be duplicated across CPU siblings. Missing/denied fields are omitted and counted as errors, never zero-filled.

scope: Four separate one-hour persistent-worker cases; absent probes are not_run/null, not zero-fault. None means no added benchmark audio/UI children, not absence of desktop activity. Worker cancellation remains logical invalidation; native-only and worker/audio/UI outcomes are distinct.
